caption: A note whose headings mix three styles.
eval: const p = app.plugins.plugins['heading-case']; p.settings.keepWords = 'Obsidian, Markdown, GitHub, New York'; p.settings.selectionOnly = true; void p.saveSettings(); const e = app.workspace.activeEditor.editor; e.setCursor({ line: 0, ch: 0 }); e.scrollTo(0, 0); 'ok'

caption: Convert headings to sentence case. GitHub and New York come from the keep list, macOS, iPhone, API and 3D are kept on their own.
eval: const e = app.workspace.activeEditor.editor; e.setCursor({ line: 0, ch: 0 }); e.scrollTo(0, 0); 'ok'

caption: Convert headings to title case. Short words stay lowercase unless they open the heading or follow a colon.
eval: const e = app.workspace.activeEditor.editor; e.setCursor({ line: 0, ch: 0 }); e.scrollTo(0, 0); 'ok'

caption: With text selected, only the headings on the selected lines change.
eval: const e = app.workspace.activeEditor.editor; let i = 0; while (i < e.lineCount() && !e.getLine(i).startsWith('## The First')) i++; e.focus(); e.setSelection({ line: i, ch: 0 }, { line: i + 4, ch: e.getLine(i + 4).length }); 'ok'

caption: The keep list and the selected lines switch.
One command fixes every heading in the note, and one undo brings them back.

frames.eval: const e = app.workspace.activeEditor.editor; e.setCursor({ line: 0, ch: 0 }); e.scrollTo(0, 0); 'ok'
